dedupe_keys.name: dynamic integrated assignment and demand modelling diadem software

description: DIADEM is a Department for Transport software tool, supplied by Atkins, for setting up variable transport demand models under TAG guidance. Its incremental hierarchical logit model represents trip frequency, time-period choice, mode choice and destination choice. Travel times and other costs come from a third-party assignment model; the provider names SATURN interfaces. Modelled geography, forecast periods and resolution depend on the application. Access is through licensed software: users with an active licence download it using an account. The standard licence is paid, with an educational option; the software licence is separate from the GOV.UK documentation terms. It supports transport demand and network-flow analysis. Caveats: no installer, manual or model was downloaded or run, and calibration requirements and current executable compatibility remain unverified. It is related to the National Transport Model through the same DfT modelling-tools collection.
